_readme: show3d: true = the site shows the 3D models (viewer, downloads, IIIF, model RDF). false = the site says nothing about 3D models. Env override: RAILCLASS_SHOW3D=1 or 0. After changing it, regenerate: python3 tools/build_rdf.py && python3 tools/build_void.py && python3 tools/build_search.py, then cd web && npm run build && npm test. See docs/notes/site.md (2026-10-15).
